messages:
jordan_prod: Hey, running into a tool.call failure when a customer sends a PowerShell here-string as the tool args. Repro below — returns a JSON parse error.

jordan_prod: Repro (PowerShell):
```powershell
$KEY = 'REDACTED'
$body = @{
  tool = 'extract_text'
  args = @{ content = @"
This is the file content
with "quotes" and a trailing comma,
"@ }
} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  --data-binary $body
```

jordan_prod: Actual error from our API gateway: `400 Bad Request - invalid JSON: Unexpected token @ in JSON at position 72`

alice_support: Thanks for the repro, Jordan. Quick Q: did the customer paste the here-string directly into the client (i.e., not serializing via ConvertTo-Json)?

jordan_prod: Yes, they pasted a raw here-string into their request body in a CLI script (PowerShell). They expected the API to accept it as a normal JSON string.

alice_support: Ok. Two quick workarounds for the customer: 1) Serialize with `ConvertTo-Json` (PowerShell) before POSTing; 2) base64-encode the content and decode server-side. Can you confirm those work?

jordan_prod: I tested `ConvertTo-Json -Compress` locally — it fixes the payload and the toolcall returns 200 with the expected tool invocation. But the customer wants to paste raw script output into our curl without extra steps.

marta_eng: I can repro this on Windows/PowerShell 7.2. The parser on our HTTP front-end treats `@"`/"@` style here-strings as unquoted tokens and fails to validate. I think we strip leading `@` incorrectly during pre-parse path.

dev-oncall: Flagging as an oncall issue. @marta_eng can you capture a minimal failing payload and any gateway logs? I'll open an incident if it's a parser regression.

marta_eng: Minimal failing payload I repro'd: 
```json
{"tool":"extract_text","args":{"content":@"This has newlines
and a trailing comma,
"@}}
```
Gateway log snippet: `ParseError: Unexpected token @ at position 37 (raw body: {"tool":"extract_text","args":{"content":@"This has newlines
...`

marta_eng: Filed internal ticket INC-2026 (toolcall-parser: mishandle PowerShell here-strings). Adding logs and repro in the ticket.

dev-oncall: Thx. Severity: P2 (customer repro + easy workaround). ETA for fix?

marta_eng: I'll put a small sanitizer in front of the JSON validator to reject bare here-string markers earlier and return a clearer 400 explaining "invalid JSON - avoid PowerShell here-strings; serialize your JSON or use ConvertTo-Json". Longer-term: add support to accept some here-string forms after safe normalization.

alice_support: For the customer reply, I'll recommend ConvertTo-Json + `--data-binary $body` or base64. Here's a sample minimal message to paste: 
```powershell
$body = @{ tool='extract_text'; args=@{ content=(Get-Content file.txt -Raw) } } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary $body
```

jordan_prod: Sent those options to the customer. They tested `ConvertTo-Json` and confirmed it works. They asked for an ETA on a server-side fix to avoid manual serialization.

marta_eng: PR in review to special-case `@'` and `@"` here-strings by rejecting them with an explicit error message (no silent parse failure). If accepted, hotfix will roll this afternoon. Longer parse-accept path tracked for 2.5 milestone.

deploy-bot: deploy started for release/infra-hotfix-2026-03-15 (marta_eng)

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded in canary, rolling to primary in 10m :rocket:

marta_eng: Rolled the hotfix. The API now returns `400 Bad Request - invalid JSON: PowerShell here-strings are not allowed; please serialize the payload (ConvertTo-Json) or escape content.` That should be clearer for customers.

jordan_prod: Customer verified the clearer error and accepted the workaround. They asked us to add a short note to the docs.

alice_support: I'll add a blurb to the troubleshooting docs: "If you use PowerShell, serialize your payload with ConvertTo-Json or use base64; do not paste here-strings directly into the request body."

marta_eng: Adding follow-up task to INC-2026: support normalized acceptance in v2 parser.

jordan_prod: Marking resolved on the customer side. Thanks team! :thumbsup:

alice_support: Closing this thread; keeping INC-2026 open for parser work.
